cards.name: Aminatou, Veil Piercer
questions: Miracle granted by a static ability has no schema field: it is a grantAbility record {kind:"cast_option",keyword:"miracle",reduceBy:"{4}"} on enchantment cards in hand. The kernel needs a "grants miracle with cost = mana cost reduced by N" capability.

cards.name: Aminatou, the Fateshifter
questions: The -6 ("each player gains control of all nonland permanents other than Aminatou controlled by the next player in the chosen direction") is a simultaneous rotation of control around the table. gain_control has no rotate/direction fields; written as gain_control with passthrough fields rotate + excludeSelf. Needs a kernel-defined rotate_control step.
-1: "Exile another target permanent you own" - the permanent returns as a NEW object (loses counters, summoning sick); expressed as exile then move_card_zone from exile to battlefield.

cards.name: Arcane Denial
questions: "Its controller may draw up to two cards": modelled as a delayed trigger whose draw step is who:controller_of_target, optional, upTo:true (number chosen by that player, 0-2). OK?

cards.name: Archaeomancer's Map
questions: "if that player controls more lands than you": the comparison uses the count of lands controlled by ANY opponent; with several opponents it should compare the specific player whose land entered. The schema has no event-player-scoped count; written with controller:"opponent".

cards.name: Athreos, Shroud-Veiled
questions: Devotion to "white and black" is written as the sum of devotion to W and devotion to B (hybrid symbols count once per symbol per the rules, which this sum matches only if the kernel counts a W/B hybrid once). OK?

cards.name: Callaphe, Beloved of the Sea
questions: Characteristic-defining "power is equal to devotion" has no dedicated modifier: written as setBasePT with toughness = its own current toughness (3 printed). The schema needs a power-only CDA modifier.
The granted tax only applies to spells that TARGET the permanent: grantAbility record carries onlyIfTargets:"self" (loose record, not validated).

cards.name: Demon of Fate's Design
questions: "Cast an enchantment spell by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost" (once each of your turns) is an alternative-cost permission granted to OTHER cards by a static ability. castOptions only describe the card's own casting, so it is a scripted marker cast_enchantment_paying_life.

cards.name: Enhanced Surveillance
questions: "Look at an additional two cards each time you surveil" modifies the surveil step (look at 2 more cards before choosing). There is no static modifier for changing another step's amount, so it is a scripted marker surveil_additional_cards {extra:2}; the surveil step needs to read it.

cards.name: Estrid's Invocation
questions: A clone-as-enters replacement with an extra granted triggered ability: the copy step carries addAbility (loose passthrough record, not validated). The kernel needs a copy-with-exceptions capability.

cards.name: Fear of Sleep Paralysis
questions: "Whenever you fully unlock a Room" has no event: written as an alsoOn alternative with event "unspecified" subject "you". The schema needs an event such as unlock_room (and "fully unlock").
"Stun counters can't be removed from permanents your opponents control" is a restriction on counter removal; no static modifier exists, so it is a scripted marker.

cards.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn
questions: Double-faced card: both faces live in one JSON (ability text prefixed with the face name as in the oracle text). The schema has no per-ability face field; the kernel needs to know that abilities a3-a4 belong to the back face (Heliod, the Warped Eclipse). The back-face flash permission is a scripted marker.

cards.name: Inkshield
questions: The shield (prevent all combat damage to you this turn) creates one Inkling per 1 damage prevented. Written as a grant_effect step carrying a replacement record (instead: create tokens with count = damage prevented). The schema cannot attach a replacement to a spell's resolution; kernel needs a prevention-shield-with-rider capability.

cards.name: Inquisitive Glimmer
questions: "Unlock costs you pay cost {1} less" (Room unlocking) has no cost-modification target: scripted marker unlock_cost_reduction.

cards.name: Lim-Dûl's Vault
questions: "As many times as you choose, you may pay 1 life ... then look at the top five again" is an optional loop chosen by the player. repeat_for_each has no "repeat while the player says yes" form; written as repeat_for_each with repeatCount "as_many_as_you_choose" (passthrough). Needs a loop-with-prompt step. The kernel loop guard (player names an iteration count) fits.

cards.name: Mystic Remora
questions: Cumulative upkeep: the unlessPay cost is {1} PER age counter; unlessPay has no multiplier, so the step carries a passthrough field costPerCounter:"age". Needs a Quantity-scaled payment.

cards.name: Omniscience
questions: A static permission to cast other cards for free has no schema form (same gap as Dracogenesis): scripted marker free_cast_from_hand.

cards.name: One with the Multiverse
questions: Three scripted permission markers (look at top card any time, play from top of library, once-per-turn free cast): the schema has no zone-permission static modifier.

cards.name: Overwhelming Splendor
questions: No way to refer to "the enchanted player" or "creatures enchanted player controls" in an ObjectFilter (controller has only you/opponent/any/defending_player). Written with controller:"opponent", which is only right in a 2-player game; the kernel must resolve it to the enchanted player. Needs controller:"enchanted_player".
"Enchanted player can't activate abilities..." is a restriction on a player: scripted marker (cant has no "activate" value).

cards.name: Secret Arcade
questions: Room: two doors in one JSON (ability text prefixed by the door name as in the oracle text). The schema has no door/unlock state: the kernel must know a3-a4 only apply while that door is unlocked, and "permanent spells you control are enchantments" also applies on the stack. The reminder lines about casting/unlocking a Room are kernel rules.

cards.name: Shadow of the Second Sun
questions: "An additional beginning phase after this phase" (untap, upkeep, draw again) has no step kind (extra_combat exists, nothing for other phases): scripted marker additional_beginning_phase on the trigger. The trigger is "at the beginning of each of the ENCHANTED PLAYER's postcombat main phases"; encoded with subject:"enchanted".

cards.name: Shark Typhoon
questions: The X of the cycling trigger is the X paid for the cycling cost (linked ability payload, spec gap 4); written as {ref:"X"} and the kernel must carry X from the cycling activation to its trigger.

cards.name: Soaring Lightbringer
questions: "Whenever you attack a player" fires once per player attacked (not per attacker) and needs that player for the token to attack: encoded as an attack trigger with batch:true and token field attackTarget:"that_player". The schema has no "attacks a player" event payload.

cards.name: Sphere of Safety
questions: attackTax.cost is a string, so the variable X (number of enchantments you control) is carried in scripted.params.x on the ability. Needs attackTax.cost as a Quantity-scaled cost.

cards.name: Starfield of Nyx
questions: "Base power and toughness each equal to ITS mana value": the quantity refers to each affected permanent, not the source. Written with ObjRef "iterated" (normally the repeat_for_each object); the schema has no "the affected object" ref for static modifiers.

cards.name: Timely Ward
questions: Conditional flash ("as though it had flash if it targets a commander") is a casting-timing condition on a target; encoded as a scripted marker flash_if_targets_commander. castOptions/timing have no "if it targets" predicate.

cards.name: Vanishing
questions: No phase_out step kind (or phased-out state): written as grant_effect with phaseOut:true; it phases in during its controller's next untap step. The kernel needs phasing.

cards.name: Virtue of Persistence
questions: Adventure card: the Adventure half (Locthwain Scorn) is a second spell_effect on the same card. Its mana cost ({1}{B}) is NOT in data/cards.db oracle text, so no cast option is written (validator would reject the mana symbols); there is no adventure cast option kind (cast Locthwain Scorn from hand, exile it, later cast the enchantment from exile). Needs an "adventure" cast option.

cards.name: Zur, Eternal Schemer
questions: Zur's activated ability has no duration in the oracle text (the enchantment stays a creature permanently, until it leaves the battlefield). duration is therefore omitted; the schema has no explicit "indefinite" duration value, so the omission has to mean permanent. Needs duration "indefinite".

decisions: Copied unchanged from other decks' drafts (identical cards): Adarkar Wastes (the-ur-dragon), Arcane Signet (calling-all-angels), Caves of Koilos (the-ur-dragon), Command Tower (saheeli), Counterspell (keen-engineering), Drowned Catacomb (the-ur-dragon), Evolving Wilds (the-ur-dragon), Glacial Fortress (the-ur-dragon), Island (keen-engineering), Isolated Chapel (the-ur-dragon), Myriad Landscape (the-ur-dragon), Negate (keen-engineering), Plains (calling-all-angels), Prairie Stream (the-ur-dragon), Propaganda (keen-engineering), Sol Ring (calling-all-angels), Sunken Palace (saheeli), Swamp (the-ur-dragon), Swords to Plowshares (calling-all-angels), Temple of Deceit (the-ur-dragon), Temple of Silence (the-ur-dragon), Underground River (the-ur-dragon).

All 87 cards were found in data/cards.db; no oracleOverride was needed. Heliod, Secret Arcade and Virtue of Persistence are double-faced / Room / Adventure cards: each is one JSON with the face-prefixed oracle lines.

VALIDATOR BUG: move_card_zone / step field order:"chosen" (put cards back in any order) is read as the ObjRef "chosen" and raises STRUCT_CHOSEN_UNDEFINED when no choose step saves it (Ponder, Halimar Depths, Portent). Workaround: passthrough field ordered:"any_order".
VALIDATOR BUG: the lexeme "another/other" fires on "choose a color other than white" (Thriving lands). Workaround: review.ignore on 'another'.

VALIDATOR NOTE: a mana ability line with "Add {W} or {B}" plus an extra sentence passes with ONE ability listing both colors in mana.produces and srcs:[0] (Talisman of Creativity pattern), but two separate mana abilities with identical text fail CLAUSE_UNCOVERED when a following sentence is present; plain dual lands with the two-ability pattern (copied drafts) still pass.
SCHEMA QUESTION: no "enchanted player" filter/controller (Overwhelming Splendor, Shadow of the Second Sun): written with controller:"opponent" / subject:"enchanted".
SCHEMA QUESTION: no field for characteristic-defining power (Callaphe: power = devotion to blue); written as setBasePT with the current toughness.

SCHEMA QUESTION: no way to grant miracle with a derived cost (Aminatou, Veil Piercer), no static free-cast / cast-from-top / alternative-cost-for-other-cards permissions (Omniscience, One with the Multiverse, Demon of Fate's Design): scripted markers.

SCHEMA QUESTION: no unlock_room event, no door state (Fear of Sleep Paralysis, Secret Arcade/Dusty Parlor), no adventure cast option (Virtue of Persistence), no phase_out step (Vanishing), no additional-phase step (Shadow of the Second Sun), no indefinite duration (Zur), no copy-with-exceptions/addAbility (Estrid's Invocation), no loop-while-player-chooses step (Lim-Dul's Vault), no rotate-control step (Aminatou, the Fateshifter -6), no Quantity-scaled attackTax cost (Sphere of Safety) or unlessPay multiplier (Mystic Remora cumulative upkeep).

SCHEMA QUESTION: no cumulative_upkeep marker in the known scripted list; written as a triggered ability with keyword cumulative_upkeep plus add_counters and sacrifice unlessPay (costPerCounter passthrough).
SCHEMA QUESTION: step field exclude (choose a color other than X) and token fields tokenAttacking / attackTarget are untyped passthrough.
